Brand Architectural Principles & Design System

Engineered under standard STD-2026-BRAND-TECHSPEC-01 to honor Steve Cormier's 36-year legacy in enterprise infrastructure engineering. Every mark is constructed on rigid mathematical grids with surgical hairline spacing, machinic mitered corners, and status telemetry nodes.

01. Optical Grid Hierarchy

Square marks align on an 8x8 or 64x64 modular grid. All traces feature 90 deg or 45 deg chamfered corners, avoiding soft decorative curves in favor of structural hardware precision.

02. Typographic Restraint

Primary wordmark uses Space Grotesk / Plus Jakarta Sans at geometric weight 800 with tight tracking. Secondary technical datums use JetBrains Mono in tabular uppercase.

03. Telemetry Indicators

Every concept integrates a live active telemetry node (#059669 Status Emerald) symbolizing 100% uptime, zero packet loss, and continuous cluster monitoring.
